Move Mouth with Wave File

Here's 2 scripts to rotate a Jaw Joint according to a recorded wav file.

Most of the work was done by Hiroto.  I just kept bugging him for tips.

"A Wave Loader.js" will read a wav file and create a *Rotation.txt file.

"A Rotater.js" will read the *Rotation.txt file and rotate a jaw joint and render to *.jpg.

There are some assumptions (15fps) and Jaw Joint must be the selected object when using "A Rotater.js".

Also, check the script to see if rotating the x or z coordinate.

You can use Blender or iMovie or both to create final output.

Attachments: [Archive.zip](https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?attachments/12900/)
